environment.description: Same application deployed behind an AWS Application Load Balancer with mutual TLS (mTLS) listener configuration. The ALB listener on port 443 is configured with 'MutualAuthentication' mode set to 'verify' using a trust store ARN (arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:us-east-1:123456789:truststore/internal-ca/abc123) that references an internal PKI CA. The trust store only contains the root CA certificate for the organization's internal PKI (managed via AWS Private CA with a short-lived subordinate). The ALB's 'MutualAuthentication.IgnoreClientCertificateExpiry' is set to false. Connection attempts without a valid client certificate signed by the trusted CA are rejected at the TLS handshake level (TCP RST before HTTP). The target group health check path is /api/health on port 8080 over HTTP (ALB to target is plaintext within VPC). Security group on the target instances only allows inbound on port 8080 from the ALB's security group CIDR. No direct internet path to the application exists.

config.vpc_config: private subnets, no IGW attached to target subnet
config.client_cert_issuance: AWS Private CA with 24h cert lifetime, issued only to registered service accounts
